description: Add an isAvailable() method to the STT object returned by createSTT() in src/stt.js that returns true when at least one provider has an API key configured

contract.raw_request: Add an isAvailable() method to the STT object returned by createSTT() in src/stt.js that returns true when at least one provider has an API key configured
contract.goal: Add an isAvailable() method to the STT object returned by createSTT() in src/stt.js that returns true when at least one provider has an API key configured
required_behavior: The STT.createSTT() function returns an object with an isAvailable() method that checks if at least one provider has an API key configured
constraints: The STT.createSTT() function must not be altered beyond adding the isAvailable() method
The isAvailable() method must not interfere with other providers' API key configurations

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The STT.createSTT() function returns an object with an isAvailable() method that correctly checks if at least one provider has an API key configured
The isAvailable() method is implemented correctly and does not break existing functionality

verification_plan: Run tests to verify that the isAvailable() method correctly returns true when at least one provider has an API key configured and false otherwise
Verify that the isAvailable() method does not affect other providers' API key configurations
Ensure that the isAvailable() method is correctly implemented
